headlines.title: Indiana Pacers Billionaire Herb Simon Sues Deceased Nephew And His Family Over A “Secret” Restructuring
headlines.summary: One of America’s richest families—thanks to stakes in mall giant Simon Property and the NBA’s Indiana Pacers—is fighting over a decades-old real-estate investment company.

headlines.title: Is a Beat in Store for Simon Property Stock in Q2 Earnings?
headlines.summary: SPG's Q2 results are likely to show revenue and FFO growth, with strong leasing and occupancy offsetting higher interest and tariff pressures.

headlines.title: Simon Property Group (SPG) Heads Into Earnings With Its Fair Value Case Under Review
headlines.summary: Simon Property Group (SPG) is in focus ahead of its second quarter 2026 earnings report, scheduled for August 10 after the market close, as investors weigh leasing strength against higher interest and tariff related costs. See our latest analysis for Simon Property Group. Despite a softer near term patch, with the 7 day share price return down 4.56% and the latest close at US$225.90, Simon Property Group still shows firm momentum. The 90 day share price return is 9.

headlines.title: Simon Property Group (SPG) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Analyst Target Increases
headlines.summary: The latest update for Simon Property Group shows a modest lift in fair value estimates, with the internal price target moving from US$224.42 to US$227.95. That shift aligns with recent Street research, where price targets are clustering higher as analysts refine funds from operations and net operating income assumptions, even while views on risk and entry points remain split.

headlines.title: Herb Simon sues family members, company run by late nephew David Simon
headlines.summary: Pacers owner Herb Simon is suing his late nephew's family, alleging David Simon improperly restructured a Simon company shortly before his death.

description: Simon Property Group, Inc. is a self-administered and self-managed real estate investment trust (REIT). Simon Property Group, L.P., or the Operating Partnership, is our majority-owned partnership subsidiary that owns all of our real estate properties and other assets. In this package, the terms Simon, we, our, or the Company refer to Simon Property Group, Inc., the Operating Partnership, and its subsidiaries. We own, develop and manage premier shopping, dining, entertainment and mixed-use destinations, which consist primarily of malls, Premium Outlets, The Mills, and International Properties. At December 31, 2024, we owned or had an interest in 229 properties comprising 183 million square feet in North America, Asia and Europe. We also owned an 88% interest in The Taubman Realty Group, or TRG, which owns 22 regional, super-regional, and outlet malls in the U.S. and Asia. Additionally, at December 31, 2024, we had a 22.4% ownership interest in Klepierre, a publicly traded, Paris-based real estate company, which owns shopping centers in 14 European countries. Simon Property Group, Inc. was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Indianapolis, Indiana.
